newsitem.title: USA: Wash Water Power, Tosco supply deal ok'd.
newsitem.headline: Wash Water Power, Tosco supply deal ok'd.

text.p: The Washington Utilities and Transportation Commission (WUTC) on Wednesday approved an application by Washington Water Power Co to supply power to Tosco Corp's Ferndale, Wash., oil refinery.
The utility plans to supply Tosco with about 20 megawatts (MW) of uninterruptible power starting in November. The contract expires December 31, 2000.
Washington Water Power will replace Public Utility District No. 1 of Whatcom County as the Tosco refinery's power supplier.
Steve Fisher, a spokesman for Washington Water Power, said the company has not yet obtained transmission capacity for the Tosco deal, but hopes to do so.
The Bonneville Power Administration, which previously supplied Whatcom PUD with power for the Tosco plant, turned down the company's request for transmission access.
Talks with Puget Sound Power and Light for similar access are ongoing, Fisher noted.
Without a final agreement on transmission, the contract with Tosco "could be delayed or it could go away," he said. "But we are pretty confident that we can secure transmission."
